description: Make a link to the person's own dashboard: their current plan next to the cheapest options for 2027 (also the cheapest if they stay with their insurer), a tracker for the deductible used this year, and the deadlines. The numbers are in the link fragment and stay in their browser. Give them the link to open.

current_insurer.description: Insurer name as printed on the letter, e.g. "Helsana"

current_monthly_premium.description: Monthly premium for basic insurance in CHF

municipality_bfs.description: BFS number from find_postcode, only needed if the postcode covers several municipalities

works_8h_per_week.description: Works at least 8 hours a week for one employer. If true, accident cover is left out because the employer covers it

yearly_health_costs.description: Doctor bills they expect next year in CHF

name: dashboard_link
title: Personal dashboard link
